# pdf-audit-export

Exports an audit table as a PDF: a write handler renders rows with renderTablePdf and uploads the bytes before the transaction (uploadFileBytesBeforeTransaction) and stores them as a FileRef (createFileRefFromUploadedBytes).

## README

# PDF Audit Export

A write handler exports tenant data as a PDF and keeps it as a FileRef.

## What it shows

- `renderTablePdf` (`@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/renderer-pdf`) draws a table document in pure JavaScript: repeating header, weighted columns, page footer. The handler passes ready-formatted strings.
- The export is a `beforeTransaction` handler: it reads the rows (reads work in that phase), renders the PDF and calls `uploadFileBytesBeforeTransaction` (`@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/files`), which validates the bytes and writes them to the tenant-prefixed storage key. The upload runs before the transaction because storage I/O inside it would hold a pool connection for as long as the upload takes.
- The handler itself calls `createFileRefFromUploadedBytes(ctx, event.prepared)` and creates the `file_refs` row and the `fileRef.created` event in the transaction. If the transaction does not commit, the phase's `release` deletes the uploaded bytes again (only when no row exists for the storage key). A crash between upload and commit leaves the bytes in storage; nothing sweeps them.
- The result is a normal FileRef: `GET /api/files/:id` serves it with `Content-Type: application/pdf`, other tenants get 404.

## Source

Feature entry point: `src/feature.ts`. The export reads at most 200 inspections per call.

## Tests

Needs a running Postgres and `TEST_DATABASE_URL` set (e.g. `postgres://postgres:postgres@127.0.0.1:5432/postgres`, see `demo/.env.example`).

```bash
cd samples/recipes/pdf-audit-export
bun test
```

### src/__tests__/feature.integration.test.ts

```ts
// PDF Audit Export Sample — Integration Test
//
// Proves the whole path through real HTTP calls: inspections are written,
// the export handler renders and stores a PDF, GET /api/files/:id serves it
// and its text contains exactly the inspections of the requested period.

import { afterAll, beforeAll, describe, expect, test } from "bun:test";
import {
  createFilesFeature,
  createInMemoryFileProvider,
} from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/files";
import {
  createTestUser,
  setupTestStack,
  type TestStack,
  testTenantId,
  unsafeCreateEntityTable,
} from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/stack";
import { extractText, getDocumentProxy } from "unpdf";
import { inspectionEntity, pdfAuditExportFeature } from "../feature";

let stack: TestStack;

const userA = createTestUser({ id: 1, tenantId: testTenantId(1), roles: ["Admin"] });
const userB = createTestUser({ id: 2, tenantId: testTenantId(2), roles: ["Admin"] });

beforeAll(async () => {
  stack = await setupTestStack({
    features: [createFilesFeature(), pdfAuditExportFeature],
    files: { storageProvider: createInMemoryFileProvider() },
  });
  await unsafeCreateEntityTable(stack.db, inspectionEntity);
});

afterAll(async () => {
  await stack.cleanup();
});

async function addInspection(
  inspectedOn: string,
  result: "ok" | "defect",
  inspector: string,
  assetName = "Kessel 3",
): Promise<void> {
  await stack.http.writeOk(
    "pdf-audit-export:write:inspection:create",
    { assetName, inspectedOn, result, inspector },
    userA,
  );
}

async function download(user: typeof userA, fileRefId: string): Promise<Response> {
  const token = await stack.jwt.sign(user);
  return stack.app.request(`/api/files/${fileRefId}`, {
    headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` },
  });
}

describe("export-audit", () => {
  test("stores a PDF FileRef containing only the inspections of the period and asset", async () => {
    await addInspection("2026-01-10", "ok", "Zeile-vor-Zeitraum");
    await addInspection("2026-02-05", "defect", "Zeile-im-Zeitraum-Eins");
    await addInspection("2026-03-20", "ok", "Zeile-im-Zeitraum-Zwei");
    await addInspection("2026-05-02", "ok", "Zeile-nach-Zeitraum");
    await addInspection("2026-02-06", "ok", "Zeile-anderer-Asset", "Pumpe 7");

    const { fileRefId } = await stack.http.writeOk<{ fileRefId: string }>(
      "pdf-audit-export:write:export-audit",
      { assetName: "Kessel 3", from: "2026-02-01", to: "2026-03-31" },
      userA,
    );

    const res = await download(userA, fileRefId);
    expect(res.status).toBe(200);
    expect(res.headers.get("Content-Type")).toBe("application/pdf");
    const proxy = await getDocumentProxy(new Uint8Array(await res.arrayBuffer()));
    const { text } = await extractText(proxy, { mergePages: true });

    expect(text).toContain("Prüfprotokoll Kessel 3");
    expect(text).toContain("05.02.2026");
    expect(text).toContain("Mangel");
    expect(text).toContain("Zeile-im-Zeitraum-Eins");
    expect(text).toContain("20.03.2026");
    expect(text).toContain("Zeile-im-Zeitraum-Zwei");
    expect(text).not.toContain("Zeile-vor-Zeitraum");
    expect(text).not.toContain("Zeile-nach-Zeitraum");
    expect(text).not.toContain("Zeile-anderer-Asset");
    expect(text).toContain("Seite 1 von 1");
  });

  test("a user of another tenant gets 404 for the exported file", async () => {
    await addInspection("2026-02-05", "ok", "Zeile-Tenant-A");
    const { fileRefId } = await stack.http.writeOk<{ fileRefId: string }>(
      "pdf-audit-export:write:export-audit",
      { assetName: "Kessel 3", from: "2026-02-01", to: "2026-03-31" },
      userA,
    );

    expect((await download(userB, fileRefId)).status).toBe(404);
  });

  test("a period without inspections still yields a PDF with the empty hint", async () => {
    const { fileRefId } = await stack.http.writeOk<{ fileRefId: string }>(
      "pdf-audit-export:write:export-audit",
      { assetName: "Unbekannte Anlage", from: "2026-02-01", to: "2026-03-31" },
      userA,
    );

    const res = await download(userA, fileRefId);
    const proxy = await getDocumentProxy(new Uint8Array(await res.arrayBuffer()));
    const { text } = await extractText(proxy, { mergePages: true });
    expect(text).toContain("Keine Prüfungen im Zeitraum");
  });

  test("a period with more inspections than the export holds is rejected instead of cut off", async () => {
    const assetName = "Großanlage";
    for (let day = 0; day < 101; day += 1) {
      const inspectedOn = new Date(Date.UTC(2025, 0, 1 + day)).toISOString().slice(0, 10);
      await addInspection(inspectedOn, "ok", `Prüfer-${day}`, assetName);
    }

    const err = await stack.http.writeErr(
      "pdf-audit-export:write:export-audit",
      { assetName, from: "2025-01-01", to: "2025-12-31" },
      userA,
    );
    expect(err.httpStatus).toBe(422);
  });
});
```

### src/feature.ts

```ts
// PDF Audit Export Sample
//
// A write handler turns tenant data into a PDF and keeps it as a regular
// FileRef: renderTablePdf draws the table (pure JS, no browser). The storage
// write runs in the beforeTransaction phase, so the transaction holds no pool
// connection while the bytes upload; the handler then only creates the
// fileRef row from event.prepared.

import { renderTablePdf } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-bundled-features/renderer-pdf";
import {
  createDateField,
  createEntity,
  createEntityExecutor,
  createSelectField,
  createTextField,
  defineFeature,
  defineWriteHandler,
} from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/engine";
import { UnprocessableError, writeFailure } from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/errors";
import {
  createFileRefFromUploadedBytes,
  uploadFileBytesBeforeTransaction,
} from "@cosmicdrift/kumiko-framework/files";
import * as z from "zod";

export const INSPECTION_RESULTS = ["ok", "defect"] as const;

export const inspectionEntity = createEntity({
  table: "read_sample_inspections",
  fields: {
    assetName: createTextField({ personal: false, reason: "is_business_data", required: true }),
    inspectedOn: createDateField({ required: true }),
    result: createSelectField({ options: INSPECTION_RESULTS, required: true }),
    inspector: createTextField({ personal: "ref" }),
  },
});

const RESULT_LABELS: Readonly<Record<(typeof INSPECTION_RESULTS)[number], string>> = {
  ok: "In Ordnung",
  defect: "Mangel",
};

// The renderer takes ready-formatted strings, so date formatting stays with the caller.
function formatGermanDate(isoDate: string): string {
  const [year, month, day] = isoDate.split("-");
  return `${day}.${month}.${year}`;
}

function toFileNameSegment(text: string): string {
  return text.replaceAll(/[^A-Za-z0-9_-]+/g, "-");
}

// One row above the limit tells "exactly full" from "cut off"; entity lists cap at 200 rows.
const AUDIT_ROW_LIMIT = 100;

const access = { access: { roles: ["Admin", "User"] } } as const;

export const pdfAuditExportFeature = defineFeature("pdf-audit-export", (r) => {
  r.entity({ name: "inspection", ...inspectionEntity });
  const { executor: inspectionExecutor } = createEntityExecutor("inspection", inspectionEntity);

  r.writeHandler({
    name: "inspection:create",
    schema: z.object({
      assetName: z.string().min(1),
      inspectedOn: z.iso.date(),
      result: z.enum(INSPECTION_RESULTS),
      inspector: z.string().optional(),
    }),
    handler: async (event, ctx) => inspectionExecutor.create(event.payload, event.user, ctx.db),
    ...access,
  });

  r.writeHandler(
    defineWriteHandler({
      name: "export-audit",
      schema: z.object({ assetName: z.string().min(1), from: z.iso.date(), to: z.iso.date() }),
      access: access.access,
      beforeTransaction: async (event, ctx) => {
        const { assetName, from, to } = event.payload;
        const inspections = await inspectionExecutor.list(
          {
            filters: [
              { field: "assetName", op: "eq", value: assetName },
              { field: "inspectedOn", op: "gte", value: from },
              { field: "inspectedOn", op: "lte", value: to },
            ],
            sort: "inspectedOn",
            sortDirection: "asc",
            limit: AUDIT_ROW_LIMIT + 1,
          },
          event.user,
          ctx.db,
        );
        // A protocol that silently drops inspections would look complete.
        if (inspections.rows.length > AUDIT_ROW_LIMIT) {
          return writeFailure(
            new UnprocessableError("audit_period_too_large", {
              details: { limit: AUDIT_ROW_LIMIT },
            }),
          );
        }

        const { pdfBytes } = await renderTablePdf({
          title: `Prüfprotokoll ${assetName}`,
          meta: [
            { label: "Zeitraum", value: `${formatGermanDate(from)} bis ${formatGermanDate(to)}` },
            { label: "Prüfungen", value: String(inspections.rows.length) },
          ],
          columns: [{ header: "Datum" }, { header: "Ergebnis" }, { header: "Prüfer", weight: 2 }],
          rows: inspections.rows.map((row) => [
            formatGermanDate(String(row["inspectedOn"])),
            RESULT_LABELS[z.enum(INSPECTION_RESULTS).parse(row["result"])],
            String(row["inspector"] ?? ""),
          ]),
          emptyText: "Keine Prüfungen im Zeitraum",
          footerText: `Prüfbericht ${assetName}`,
          pageLabel: "Seite {page} von {pages}",
        });

        return uploadFileBytesBeforeTransaction(ctx, {
          fileName: `audit-${toFileNameSegment(assetName)}.pdf`,
          mimeType: "application/pdf",
          data: pdfBytes,
        });
      },
      handler: async (event, ctx) => {
        const created = await createFileRefFromUploadedBytes(ctx, event.prepared);
        if (!created.isSuccess) return created;
        return { isSuccess: true as const, data: { fileRefId: created.data.id } };
      },
    }),
  );
});
```
